# netcup_clouddns_record (Data Source)

One record of a revision of a domain on CloudDNS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_clouddns_record" "example" {
  domain_id  = 12345
  identifier = "59994952-e024-4871-b04d-546d66f25e73"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) Id of the domain.
- `identifier` (String) Identifier of the record.

### Optional

- `revision_id` (String) Identifier of the revision. Defaults to the active one.

### Read-Only

- `immutable` (Boolean) The `immutable` value of the netcup API.
- `name` (String) Record name relative to the zone.
- `rdata` (String) Record data in zone file format.
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds, if the record has one.
- `type` (String) Record type.
